# openrouter_preset (Data Source)

Preset DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openrouter_preset" "my_preset" {
  slug         = "my-preset"
  workspace_id = "750e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440002"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) URL-safe slug identifying the preset.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to act in. Also accepted as a `workspace_id` field in a JSON request body. Defaults to the key's workspace for a key limited to one workspace, otherwise to the account's default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes) A preset with its currently designated version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `creator_user_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `designated_version` (Attributes) A specific version of a preset, containing config and optional system prompt. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--designated_version))
- `designated_version_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `status` (String) The status of a preset.
- `status_updated_at` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `workspace_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--data--designated_version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.designated_version`

Read-Only:

- `config` (Map of String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `creator_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `preset_id` (String)
- `system_prompt` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number)
